description: Recorded by three separate refutation rounds (109's bycatch triage, 132's sweep): fixtures2/00424_protocol_no_impl.fz -- a defprotocol/no-impl program -- panics with 'product materialization should have complete call edges after waits' (jobs/artifact.rs:~155) identically at every measured revision, on interp; the only run-varying byte is the panic header's thread id. A user-facing INTERNAL PANIC on a legal-shaped (if erroneous) program: should be a diagnostic (protocol lacks an impl) not an expect(). Unowned until now. Related: fz-kdt.2 (protocol domain), fz-kdt.11 (defimpl panics).
title: 00424_protocol_no_impl panics inside product materialization at base: unowned pre-existing internal panic
